jobs.title: Product Lead, Inpatient
jobs.description:
About Us:

Here at Ambience, we never set out to be just another scribe. We’re building the AI intelligence platform that restores humanity to healthcare and drives meaningful ROI for health systems across the country.

Our technology helps providers focus on delivering great care by removing the administrative burden that pulls them away from patients and away from their most impactful work. Ambience delivers real-time coding-aware documentation and clinical workflow support across ambulatory, emergency and inpatient settings at the top health systems in North America.

Our teams operate relentlessly with extreme ownership to build the best solutions for our health system partners. We value candor, positivity and deep thought — and we expect a lot from each other because we know the problems we’re solving truly matter.

Ambience was ranked #1 for Improving the Clinician Experience in the KLAS Research Emerging Solutions Top 20 Report, recognized by Fast Company as one of the Next Big Things in Tech, named one of the best AI companies in healthcare by Inc., and selected as a LinkedIn Top Startup in 2024 and 2025. We’re backed by Oak HC/FT, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), OpenAI Startup Fund, and Kleiner Perkins — and we’re just getting started.




THE ROLE

As our PM Lead, Inpatient Clinical Workflows, you'll own the clinician-facing features at the heart of Ambience's inpatient platform - the documentation and chart intelligence capabilities that define the core product experience for hospitalists and specialists.

You'll be accountable for two product pillars. First, Inpatient Scribe - the documentation experience purpose-built for inpatient workflows, from admission through discharge, handling the full complexity of rounding, handoffs, multidisciplinary coordination, and discharge summaries. Second, Chart Summarization (Patient Summary & Chart Chat) - the AI-powered chart intelligence layer that enables inpatient clinicians to rapidly synthesize patient history, surface relevant clinical context, and interact conversationally with the medical record.

Done well, this role makes Ambience indispensable for inpatient clinicians - transforming how hospitalists and specialists document, synthesize, and act on clinical information across the entire care episode.

This is a Lead PM role - you'll work closely with engineering, design, Clinical AI/ML, and GTM teams.

We're a hybrid company headquartered in San Francisco. This role requires being in the SF office 3x/week.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN


INPATIENT SCRIBE

 - Define and execute the Inpatient Scribe roadmap for hospitalists and specialists, grounded in deep understanding of inpatient documentation workflows, rounding patterns, and EHR integration requirements.

 - Deliver a documentation experience that handles the unique complexity of inpatient care: multi-encounter days, team-based rounding, procedure documentation, handoff notes, and discharge summaries.

 - Drive measurable clinician outcomes - time-to-chart, documentation completeness, reduced after-shift charting - and demonstrate clear ROI for hospital administrators.

 - Own inpatient quality metrics - accuracy, latency, note completeness, workflow completion rates - and systematically eliminate the pain points that drive support escalations or clinician drop-off.

 - Partner with Engineering and Clinical AI/ML to adapt ambient capture and note generation models to inpatient-specific language patterns, workflows, and note types.


CHART SUMMARIZATION - PATIENT SUMMARY & CHART CHAT

 - Own the product vision and roadmap for Patient Summary and Chart Chat within the inpatient setting, purpose-built for hospitalists and specialists managing complex, multi-day patient episodes.

 - Define the summarization experience that surfaces the right clinical context at the right moment: admission summaries, problem-oriented views, medication reconciliation context, overnight event recaps, and trend analysis across the hospital stay.

 - Own Chart Chat as a conversational interface to the medical record - enabling natural-language questions about patient history, labs, imaging, prior encounters, and evolving clinical trajectories.

 - Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks for summarization accuracy, completeness, and clinical safety in the inpatient context, partnering with Clinical AI/ML and clinical advisors.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


MUST-HAVES

 - 5+ years of product management experience with direct ownership of a vertical product line or platform, including roadmap and end-to-end product experience.

 - Track record of rapidly building deep domain expertise in a complex, unfamiliar domain.

 - Strong technical fluency - comfort with AI/ML products, API integrations, and complex system design.

 - Experience driving adoption in complex enterprise environments with multi-persona buying committees.

 - Based in SF, available to be in the office 3x/week.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Healthcare or regulated-industry experience (a plus, not a requirement - we hire on scorecard competencies, not domain pedigree).

 - Experience with ambient AI, NLP, clinical documentation, or chart summarization technology.

 - Prior 0-to-1 product vertical experience.




Life at Ambience 

Working at Ambience means opting into a high-ownership, high-trust environment built for people who want to grow fast, operate decisively and focus on work that matters. This could be the right place for you if you want to

 - Work on mission-critical AI technology that directly improves clinicians’ day-to-day lives and health system financial health across some of the most complex, high-stakes workflows in the world.

 - Join a “dream team” culture where we hire exceptional people, expect exceptional outcomes and invest deeply in feedback and continuous growth. We operate as a championship team, and that means being ok with hard, uncomfortable, ambiguous problems that lead to real greatness.

 - Operate with real ownership and accountability in an environment where there are no bystanders: If something is broken, we fix it! You will have meaningful autonomy and be expected to drive work to completion.

To help you do your best work, we pair these expectations with benefits intentionally designed to help you feel supported and safe at Ambience and beyond. Some of our key benefits include

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) with a company match of up to 3% of base salary

 - A remote-friendly culture (with a San Francisco HQ) and full equipment provisioning to ensure you can work effectively from wherever you’re based.

 - Parental leave to support your family needs

 - Annual company-wide off-sites, team off-sites and regular team lunches and all-hands gatherings, with travel, lodging and meals covered

 - Flexible time off with no annual cap, company-wide holidays and an annual holiday shutdown from December 24–January 1 designed to support real rest and long-term sustainability.



Ambience Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Ambience is committed to supporting every candidate’s ability to fully participate in our hiring process. If you need any accommodations during your application or interviews, please reach out to our Recruiting team at accommodations@ambiencehealthcare.com recruiting@ambiencehealth.com. We’ll handle your request confidentially and work with you to ensure an accessible and equitable experience for all candidates.


Ambience Healthcare has become aware of scams targeting jobseekers with fake jobs and even interviewing people. Our emails will always come from @ambiencehealthcare.com. We would never our ask candidates to download apps or make any form of payment(s). If you are contacted through WhatsApp, Telegram, similar but fake email domains, or asked to make a payment, these contacts are not legitimate. Report the issue immediately to LinkedIn and the FBI https://www.fbi.gov/how-we-can-help-you/scams-and-safety.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own Chorus, the platform underneath every Ambience product across care settings. This PMM owns how Chorus shows up in the market: product- and suite-level positioning and messaging, launch governance, competitive and market intelligence, and the feedback loop between field signal and product strategy. The role sits deeper in the stack than a typical PMM seat. You need to understand how the platform works, not just how it's positioned.

Reporting directly to our Head of Marketing and working closely with our Product team, this is a high-visibility individual contributor role on a small but senior product marketing team, with real scope and room to grow as the team and function scale.



What You’ll Do:

•       Own positioning and messaging for Chorus at the product and suite level, with sign-off authority over product claims and roadmap representations before they reach the market. Your messaging ladders up to the company narrative owned by Comms.

•       Run launch governance across the product roadmap: triage and tier every release, decide what gets external amplification and what stays as internal enablement, and ensure the field is trained before anything goes live — against a PM org that ships fast.

•       Build the competitive and market intelligence function for Chorus, sourcing from sales, account management, CRM, and call recordings, and feeding insight back into product and messaging decisions.

•       Maintain battlecards that sellers actually use and refresh them fast. Know what competitors say about themselves versus what they deliver, and keep the sales team ahead of it.

•       Own campaigns tied to product launches and platform milestones end to end: set the narrative, define goals, and coordinate across Sales Enablement, Comms, Growth, and Events.

•       Step into other product areas and care settings as the platform grows — including new products built on Chorus and coverage across the PMM team when needed.



Who You Are:

•       7–10+ years of B2B product marketing experience, ideally with meaningful time marketing technical infrastructure or platforms (data infrastructure, cloud platforms, AI/ML tooling).

•       Experience owning product-level positioning and messaging within a broader company narrative. You know how to make the product story land without drifting from the top-level message.

•       Track record of running launch governance in a fast-shipping product environment — triaging, tiering, and deciding what gets external amplification and what doesn't.

•       Strong market and competitive acumen, with experience maintaining battlecards that sales actually uses — sourced from win/loss data and customer perception, and refreshed fast enough to stay ahead of competitor moves.

•       Track record of feeding field intelligence back into product and positioning decisions, sourced directly from sales, CRM, and customer conversations.

•       Experience owning product-associated campaigns end to end — narrative, goals, and cross-functional coordination across enablement, comms, growth, and events.



Nice to Have:

•       Strong healthcare or health-system domain experience, including familiarity with the EHR ecosystem, clinical vs. financial buyer personas, and the health system purchasing process.

•       Experience marketing a platform that supports multiple product lines or care settings.

•      Some startup or high-growth experience where the role and the processes weren't fully defined when you got there.
